out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label: FOR MUSSELS AND OYSTERS STORED IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE TAGS ONLY AFTER LAST PIECE IS SOLD AND DATE. KEEP DATED TAGS FOR 90 DAYS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: DISHES PLACED IN DISHWASHING MACHINE FOR CLEANING, SANITIZER MEASURED 0PPM AT END OF CLEANING CYCLE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE EMPLOYEE SET UP THE SANITIZER BASIN OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WITH CHLORINE SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION FOR SANITIZING DISHES AFTER WASHING AND RINSING USING THE DISHWASHING MACHINE.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOPS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE KNIVES FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. INTERNATIONAL TOWN & COUNTRY (Inspection Date: 08/11/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that BOXES OF SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination IN MAIN DRY STORAGE AREA (BASEMENT)
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO STORE SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHING MACHINE UNABLE TO DISPENSE SANITIZER AT 50-200 PPM TO SANITIZE DISHES. SANITIZER MEASURED AT 0 PPM.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REQUESTED SERVICE FOR EQUIPMENT DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions USING ECOLAB SINK AND SURFACE SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ONLINE ORDER FOR SANITIZER TEST STRIPS DURING INSPECTION. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE CHLORINE SANITIZER FOR SANITIZING DISHES UNTIL TEST STRIPS ARE PROVIDED FOR SINK AND SURFACE SANITIZER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink: AT END OF DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PROVIDE HANDSOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASH SINKS ARE PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tags or labels.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DATE OYSTERS TAGS ONCE LAST FROM BATCH IS SOLD OR SERVED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: GARLIC AIOLI AT 78F ON AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP (COOKERS).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE DISCARDED GARLIC AIOLI DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: PASTA AT 51-62F IN COVERED CONTAINERS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR (2 HOURS); DICED TOMATOES AT 48F, BLANCHED BROCCOLI AT 46F, PASTA AT 51F, DICED CHICKEN AT 62F IN CONTINENTAL 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR (ALL COVERED FOR 3 HOURS).
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO TRANSFER TO SMALLER PORTIONS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR FOR RAPID COOLING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED SEALED ROP SALMON AND TUNA THAWING IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO SLIT OR REMOVE PACKAGING TO CONTINUE THAWING OF FISH. PLEASE ENSURE FROZEN FISH ROP IS EITHER REMOVED FROM PACKAGING OR PACKAGING IS SLIT OPEN ONCE REMOVED FROM FREEZER TO THAW.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR PREP TOP (GRILL) AND 2 DOOR PREP TOP (SALAD STATION)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC PROVIDED THERMOMETERS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SAUCES ON PREP TOP AND CONTAINERS OF SPICES OPPOSITE COOKERS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY LABLES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SOUR CREAM AT 48F, MILK AT 48F, PORTIONED SALSA AT 45F AND SOUR CREAM AT 45F IN TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT; CUT TOMATOES AT 45F, SLICED HAM AT 47F, SLICED TURKEY AT 48F IN HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED SOUR CREAM AND MILK FROM TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT. ALL OTHER TCS FOODS WERE TRANSFERRED TO THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR FOR COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW. INTERNATIONAL TOWN & COUNTRY (Inspection Date: 02/13/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required for ROP
violations.observation: A HACCP Plan was not submitted prior to engaging in: ROP OF CORN BEEF DATED 03/24; WILD BOAR 08/31; VEAL DATED 12/24.
violations.corrective_action: SUBMIT HACCP PLAN FOR ROP FOODS TO BE HELD FOR MORE THAN 48 HOURS. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD ALL ROP FOODS PREPARED IN HOUSE AND HELD FOR MORE THAN 48 HOURS. FACILITY IS ALLOWED TO ROP MEATS WHICH MUST BE USED WITHIN 48 HOURS OF PACKAGING WITHOUT A HACCP PLAN.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR PREP TOP (GRILL) AND 2 DOOR PREP TOP (SALAD STATION).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL UNITS ARE EQUIPPED WITH FUNCTIONAL THERMOMETERS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT 42-45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC REMOVED TCS FOODS COOLING AND DISCARDED FOOD STORED FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS. DO NOT USE UNIT TO STORE TCS FOODS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW.
